 (5)  CITY MANAGER REPORTS

  a.  PRESENTATION - CIVIC CENTER MASTER PLAN PRELIMINARY DESIGN
  OPTIONS
  Donna Harris commented on the Civic Center Master Plan.
  Sonia Savoulian commented on the Civic Center Master Plan.
  Bozwena Zaworski commented on the Civic Center Master Plan.
  Judie Johnson commented on the Civic Center Master Plan.
  Mary Strauss commented on the Civic Center Master Plan.
  Pam Dutch-Hughes commented on the Civic Center Master Plan.
  Diana Phillips commented on the Civic Center Master Plan.
  City Council directed staff to proceed with Phase 1 of the Civic Center Master
  Plan, focusing on the Campus design for Phase 1; and directed staff to return to
  City Council with a conceptual plan and funding options.
(6)  COUNCIL AGENDA--NEW BUSINESS

  Council Member Wilson announced the Daisy Parade on Saturday, December 9 at
  5:00 p.m.

  Mayor Hansen announced the Mayor's reception immediately following the City Council
  meeting on December 12.
(7)  ADJOURNMENT
  It was moved by COUNCIL MEMBER WILSON and seconded by VICE MAYOR
  WOODS, to adjourn tonight's meeting to the next regular Signal Hill City Council
  meeting on Tuesday, December 12, 2023 at 6:00 p.m. There will be no Signal Hill City
  Council meeting on December 26, 2023.

  MAYOR HANSEN adjourned the meeting at 7:59 p.m.

AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
The City of Signal Hill appreciates your attendance. Citizen interest provides the Council and Agency with valuable information regarding issues of the community.  Meetings are held on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday of every month. 

Meetings begin at 6:00 pm with the conduct of any business permitted to be conducted in closed session by the Brown Act (Government Code Section 54950, et seq.), if any, and with the public portion of the meeting beginning at 7:00 pm. There is a period for public comment on closed session matters at 6:00 pm prior to the closed session. In the event there is no business to be conducted in closed session, the regular meeting shall begin at 7:00 pm. There is a public comment period at the beginning of the regular meeting.  Any person wishing to comment shall be allotted three minutes per distinct item. Any meeting may be adjourned to a time and place stated in the order of adjournment.

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting on the City’s website and outside of City Hall. The agenda and related reports are also available for review online at www.cityofsignalhill.org.
